import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n;
    static int t;
    static Room[][] floorplan = new Room[10][10];

    // Inner class for Room
    static class Room {
        int i, j;
        boolean[] infected = new boolean[61];
        boolean[] accessible = new boolean[61];
        int scientists;
        int capsules;

        Room() {
            scientists = 0;
            capsules = 0;
            Arrays.fill(infected, false);
            Arrays.fill(accessible, true);
        }

        int getNodeId(int timestamp) {
            return 2 + i + n * j + n * n * timestamp;
        }

        void setReactor() {
            Arrays.fill(accessible, false);
        }

        void setInfected(int timestamp) {
            if (accessible[timestamp]) {
                accessible[timestamp] = false;
                infected[timestamp] = true;
            }
        }

        void spreadInfection(int timestamp) {
            if (infected[timestamp]) {
                setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (i > 0) floorplan[i - 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (i < (n - 1)) floorplan[i + 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (j > 0) floorplan[i][j - 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (j < (n - 1)) floorplan[i][j + 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    // Edge class
    static class Edge {
        int from;
        int to;
        double length;

        Edge(int f, int t, double l) {
            from = f;
            to = t;
            length = l;
        }
    }

    // Node class
    static class Node {
        List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>(); // indices of edges starting here
    }

    // Graph class
    static class Graph {
        List<Node> nodes = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();

        Graph(int nrNodes, int nrEdges) {
            for (int i = 0; i < nrNodes; i++) nodes.add(new Node());
            // edges will be added dynamically
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, double length) {
            Edge e = new Edge(from, to, length);
            edges.add(e);
            nodes.get(from).out.add(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        // Helper class for augmenting path result
        static class PathResult {
            List<Integer> edges = new ArrayList<>();
            double capacity;
        }

        PathResult findAugmentingPath(int source, int sink, double[] flow) {
            // Priority queue ordered by descending capacity
            PriorityQueue<NodeCap> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Double.compare(b.cap, a.cap));
            double[] capacity = new double[nodes.size()];
            int[] pred = new int[nodes.size()];
            Arrays.fill(capacity, 0.0);
            Arrays.fill(pred, -1);

            capacity[source] = Double.MAX_VALUE;
            pq.add(new NodeCap(Double.MAX_VALUE, source));

            while (!pq.isEmpty() && capacity[sink] == 0.0) {
                NodeCap top = pq.poll();
                double cap = top.cap;
                int u = top.node;

                // Stale entry check
                if (cap < capacity[u]) continue;

                Node node = nodes.get(u);
                for (int eIdx : node.out) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(eIdx);
                    double eCap = e.length - flow[eIdx];
                    if (eCap > 0) {
                        double newCap = Math.min(cap, eCap);
                        if (newCap > capacity[e.to]) {
                            capacity[e.to] = newCap;
                            pred[e.to] = eIdx;
                            pq.add(new NodeCap(newCap, e.to));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            PathResult res = new PathResult();
            res.capacity = capacity[sink];
            if (res.capacity > 0) {
                int eIdx = pred[sink];
                while (eIdx != -1) {
                    res.edges.add(eIdx);
                    eIdx = pred[edges.get(eIdx).from];
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        double maxFlow(int source, int sink) {
            Graph residual = new Graph(nodes.size(), 2 * edges.size());
            double[] flow = new double[2 * edges.size()]; // enough for residual edges
            // Note: flow array size should be max number of edges in residual, which we can set as double[edges.size()*2]
            // But since we add edges to residual, we'll also add to flow accordingly. Simpler: use a map or arraylist? 
            // We'll adjust: we will store flow per edge index in residual graph. Since residual graph has its own edges list,
            // we can create a flow array as double[residual.edges.size()]. But we don't know the size in advance. 
            // In C++, they reserved space but flow size is 2*edges.size(). Since we add edges dynamically, we can set flow = new double[2*originalEdges.size()]? But residual adds edges for each original edge (forward+reverse). So total edges = 2*originalEdges.size(). We'll create flow array accordingly.
            int origEdgeCount = edges.size();
            double[] residualFlow = new double[2 * origEdgeCount]; // indices 0..2*origEdgeCount-1

            // Build residual graph
            for (int i = 0; i < origEdgeCount; i++) {
                Edge e = edges.get(i);
                residual.addEdge(e.from, e.to, e.length);
                residual.addEdge(e.to, e.from, 0.0);
            }

            PathResult augPath = residual.findAugmentingPath(source, sink, residualFlow);
            while (augPath.capacity > 0) {
                double pathCap = augPath.capacity;
                for (int eIdx : augPath.edges) {
                    int eRidx = (eIdx % 2 == 1) ? (eIdx - 1) : (eIdx + 1);
                    residualFlow[eIdx] += pathCap;
                    residualFlow[eRidx] -= pathCap;
                }
                augPath = residual.findAugmentingPath(source, sink, residualFlow);
            }

            double maxFlow = 0.0;
            Node srcNode = residual.nodes.get(source);
            for (int eIdx : srcNode.out) {
                maxFlow += residualFlow[eIdx];
            }
            return maxFlow;
        }

        void printAll() {
            for (int i = 0; i < nodes.size(); i++) {
                Node node = nodes.get(i);
                System.out.print(idToString(i) + " has edges to: ");
                for (int eIdx : node.out) {
                    System.out.print(idToString(edges.get(eIdx).to) + " ");
                }
                System.out.println();
            }
        }

        static String idToString(int id) {
            if (id == 0) return "source";
            if (id == 1) return "sink";
            int row = (id - 2) % n;
            int col = ((id - 2 - row) % (n * n)) / n;
            int timestamp = (id - 2 - row - col * n) / (n * n);
            return "(" + row + "," + col + "," + timestamp + ")";
        }

        // Helper class for priority queue
        static class NodeCap {
            double cap;
            int node;
            NodeCap(double c, int n) { cap = c; node = n; }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();

        // Initialize floorplan
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                floorplan[i][j] = new Room();
                floorplan[i][j].i = i;
                floorplan[i][j].j = j;
            }
        }

        // Read scientist locations (first n lines)
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') {
                    floorplan[i][j].setReactor();
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].setInfected(0);
                } else {
                    floorplan[i][j].scientists = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // Read capsule locations (next n lines)
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch != 'Y' && ch != 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].capsules = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // Simulate infection spread
        for (int c = 0; c <= t; c++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (c < t) {
                        floorplan[i][j].spreadInfection(c);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Build graph
        Graph g = new Graph(n * n * (t + 1) + 2, 100 * 4 * 60);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                Room room = floorplan[i][j];
                if (room.scientists > 0) {
                    g.addEdge(0, room.getNodeId(0), room.scientists);
                }
                if (room.capsules > 0) {
                    g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(t), 1, room.capsules);
                }
                for (int c = 0; c < t; c++) {
                    if (room.capsules > 0) {
                        g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), room.getNodeId(t), 1000);
                    }
                    if (room.accessible[c]) {
                        // Up
                        if (i > 0) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i - 1][j];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) {
                                g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), other.getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                        // Down
                        if (i < (n - 1)) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i + 1][j];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) {
                                g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), other.getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                        // Left
                        if (j > 0) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i][j - 1];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) {
                                g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), other.getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                        // Right
                        if (j < (n - 1)) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i][j + 1];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) {
                                g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), other.getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Optionally print graph (commented out in original)
        // g.printAll();

        System.out.println((int) g.maxFlow(0, 1));
        sc.close();
    }
}
